districtFact: DCSD publishes a conventional academic calendar for most district schools. The calendar separates regular student days from teacher work days, professional development days, compensation days, district holidays, and PLC delayed-start dates.

about.title: About the DCSD School Calendar
about.content: DCSD publishes a conventional academic calendar for most district schools. Schools may publish campus-specific bell schedules, PLC start times, testing dates, conferences, and events separately.

about.title: Conventional Calendar Scope
about.content: This page summarizes DCSD’s conventional district calendar. Renaissance Elementary Magnet School, Daniel C. Oakes High School, Eagle Academy, and DCSD charter schools may publish separate calendars.

planningTips.title: DCSD Calendar Notes
content: The PDF color key separates student attendance days from no-student teacher work, professional development, compensation, orientation, and district-office holiday dates.
On PLC days, check your school’s bell schedule and transportation notice.
Fall Break, Thanksgiving, Winter Break, and Spring Break are the main multi-day student closures for travel and child-care planning.
Individual DCSD schools may add testing, conference, activity, graduation, or campus-specific schedule details beyond the conventional district PDF.

districtFaqs.q: How many student days are in the Douglas County School District calendar?
districtFaqs.a: DCSD’s conventional calendar lists 173 student days for the reviewed school years.

districtFaqs.q: Does DCSD use a conventional school calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. DCSD publishes conventional academic calendars. Some schools and programs may publish separate schedules.

districtFaqs.q: What does PLC Day mean on the DCSD calendar?
districtFaqs.a: PLC Day is labeled as a delayed-start day in the district PDF key. The calendar identifies the dates, but the school should confirm the actual start time and transportation instructions.

districtFaqs.q: Where can families verify Douglas County school calendar changes?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official DCSD academic calendars page and the current school-year PDF for final confirmation. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and is not affiliated with Douglas County School District.
